dct_description_sm: This proposal addresses several priority research areas in the NCP Blueprint for the Environmental Monitoring and Research subprogram (Pathways, Processes and Effects) for 2009-10: (i) processes of contaminant deposition and factors that influence the exchange of contaminants between different abiotic compartments of the Arctic environment, (ii) processes and pathways that deliver contaminants to Arctic marine ecosystems through the oceans, and (iii) the influence of climate change on contaminant pathways and processes. Our main objectives for 2009-10 were to: (1) quantify the atmospheric input of THg and MMHg in snow, glacial meltwaters, stream and lake waters of Auyuittuq National Park, (2) investigate the effect of enhanced summer thaw on storage and release of Hg in glacial ice, and (3) investigate the relationship between atmospheric deposition of MMHg and marine aerosols (e.g., SO42-, Br-) in snow and ice deposited under present and past (different) environmental conditions (e.g., reduced sea-ice cover). This project was took place under the Geoscience for Environmental Sustainability program of Natural Resources Canada (NRCan).
dct_subject_sm: Health sciences and contaminants -> Total gaseous mercury
dct_title_s: Atmospheric deposition and release of methylmercury in glacially-fed catchments of Auyuittuq National Park, Baffin Island
